app.name: Kisan Scheme Saathi
app.tagline: From Scheme Confusion to Application Readiness
app.subtitle: Explainable, farmer-centric government scheme eligibility and application-readiness assistant.
app.disclaimer: Final eligibility and benefit approval are determined by the responsible government authority. This platform provides deterministic pre-application advisory.

hero.title: Clear Scheme Eligibility for Karnataka Farmers
hero.description: Never guess which agricultural subsidy or welfare benefit applies to you. Saathi analyzes your land, crop, and registration records with deterministic rules to tell you exactly where you qualify, what is missing, and how to apply.

howItWorks.title: Three Simple Steps to Application Readiness
howItWorks.subtitle: Transparent, deterministic, and free of vague AI promises
howItWorks.step1Desc: Enter basic district, landholding, crop, and existing portal ID details in simple Kannada or English.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Authoritative criteria evaluate each requirement. You see exactly what is satisfied, failed, or pending verification.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Follow the customized document checklist and official government portal steps to apply with confidence.

questionnaire.title: Farmer Profile & Eligibility Questionnaire
questionnaire.subtitle: Answer simple questions to determine verified scheme eligibility across Karnataka
questionnaire.ownLand: Yes, own agricultural land with RTC/Pahani
questionnaire.noLand: No, cultivate leased land or agricultural laborer
questionnaire.waterSource: Do you have an active perennial water source?
questionnaire.waterSourceDesc: Open well, borewell, canal, river or farm pond
questionnaire.existingBorewell: Do you already have an energized irrigation borewell on this land?
questionnaire.cooperativeMember: Are you an active member of a Rural Co-operative Society (PACS/DCCB/Milk Dairy)?
questionnaire.higherEduChildren: Do you have children currently enrolled in post-matric / college / university education?
questionnaire.notifiedCropHobli: Is your crop notified for insurance in your gram panchayat / hobli?
questionnaire.fruitsId: Do you possess an active Karnataka FRUITS ID (FID)?
questionnaire.rtcRecord: Do you have an updated RTC / Pahani record in Bhoomi portal?
questionnaire.aadhaarNpci: Is your Aadhaar seeded with an active NPCI Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) bank account?
questionnaire.casteIncomeCert: Do you hold a valid RD Caste & Income Certificate from Nadakacheri?
questionnaire.sowingCert: Have you completed Karnataka Bele Sameekshe (Crop Survey) for current season?
questionnaire.institutionalLand: Is the land registered under an institution, trust, temple, or company?
questionnaire.constitutionalPost: Does anyone in the family hold a constitutional/elected post (MP, MLA, MLC, Mayor)?
questionnaire.govtEmployee: Is anyone in the family a regular government/PSU employee?
questionnaire.incomeTax: Did you or your spouse pay income tax in the last assessment year?
questionnaire.esiCghs: Are you covered under corporate ESI, CGHS, or government employee health schemes?
questionnaire.quickLoadDesc: Pre-fill with realistic Karnataka small farmer data for instant evaluation

statusDescs.INTERESTED: Considering applying; reviewing rules and eligibility prerequisites.
statusDescs.PREPARING: Gathering necessary documents such as Pahani (RTC), Aadhaar, caste/income certificates.
statusDescs.READY_TO_APPLY: All mandatory documents verified; prepared for online or CSC submission.
statusDescs.APPLIED: Application submitted at Grama One, Raitha Samparka Kendra, or online portal.
statusDescs.UNDER_REVIEW: Verification in progress by Village Accountant, Agricultural Officer, or committee.
statusDescs.APPROVED: Sanction order issued or subsidy amount credited to bank account.
statusDescs.REJECTED: Application rejected due to criteria failure or land quota fulfillment.
statusDescs.NEEDS_CORRECTION: Department requested correction or re-upload of specific documents.
statusDescs.WITHDRAWN: Decided not to pursue this scheme application.
